12-01.a: هذا ذِکْرٌ وَ إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقينَ لَحُسْنَ مَآبٍ
12-01.t: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return

12-02.t: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.

12-03.a: وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الَّذينَ آمَنُوا وَ عَمِلُوا الصَّالِحاتِ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَ أَجْرٌ عَظيمٌ
12-03.t: Allah has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds [that] for them there is forgiveness and great reward.

12-04.t: And establish prayer at the two ends of the day and at the approach of the night. Indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds. That is a reminder for those who remember.

12-05.a: إِنْ تَجْتَنِبُوا کَبائِرَ ما تُنْهَوْنَ عَنْهُ نُکَفِّرْ عَنْکُمْ سَيِّئاتِکُمْ وَ نُدْخِلْکُمْ مُدْخَلاً کَريماً
12-05.t: If you avoid the major sins which you are forbidden, We will remove from you your lesser sins and admit you to a noble entrance [into Paradise].

12-06.a: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ غَيْبَ السَّماواتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ وَ اللَّهُ بَصيرٌ بِما تَعْمَلُونَ
12-06.t: Indeed, Allah knows the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Seeing of what you do.

12-07.t: Woe to every scorner and mocker

12-08.t: And [remember] when your Lord proclaimed, 'If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favor]; but if you deny, indeed, My punishment is severe.'

12-09.t: Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you

12-10.a: وَ أَنْفِقُوا في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ وَ لا تُلْقُوا بِأَيْديکُمْ إِلَى التَّهْلُکَةِ وَ أَحْسِنُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنينَ
12-10.t: And spend in the way of Allah and do not throw [yourselves] with your [own] hands into destruction [by refraining]. And do good; indeed, Allah loves the doers of good.

12-11.a: مَنْ ذَا الَّذي يُقْرِضُ اللَّهَ قَرْضاً حَسَناً فَيُضاعِفَهُ لَهُ أَضْعافاً کَثيرَةً وَ اللَّهُ يَقْبِضُ وَ يَبْصُطُ وَ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
12-11.t: Who is it that would loan Allah a goodly loan so He may multiply it for him many times over? And it is Allah who withholds and grants abundance, and to Him you will be returned.

12-12.t: Indeed, Allah loves the doers of good.

12-13.t: And We have enjoined upon man, to his parents, good treatment. His mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship, and his gestation and weaning [period] is thirty months. [He grows] until, when he reaches maturity and reaches [the age of] forty years, he says, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims."

12-14.t: And tell My servants to say that which is best. Indeed, Satan induces [dissension] among them. Indeed Satan is ever, to mankind, a clear enemy.

12-15.a: رَبَّنا لا تَجْعَلْنا فِتْنَةً لِلَّذينَ کَفَرُوا وَ اغْفِرْ لَنا رَبَّنا إِنَّکَ أَنْتَ الْعَزيزُ الْحَکيمُ
12-15.t: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] torment for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

12-16.a: الَّذينَ إِذا ذُکِرَ اللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَ الصَّابِرينَ عَلى ما أَصابَهُمْ وَ الْمُقيمِي الصَّلاةِ وَ مِمَّا رَزَقْناهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ
12-16.t: Who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts are fearful, and [to] the patient over what has afflicted them, and the establishers of prayer and those who spend from what We have provided them.

12-17.a: أَ وَ لَمْ يَرَوْا کَيْفَ يُبْدِئُ اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعيدُهُ إِنَّ ذلِکَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسيرٌ
12-17.t: Have they not considered how Allah begins creation and then repeats it? Indeed that, for Allah , is easy.

12-18.t: Whoever disbelieves - upon him is [the consequence of] his disbelief. And whoever does righteousness - they are for themselves preparing,

12-19.t: So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And let them not disquiet you who are not certain [in faith].

12-20.t: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Luqman said to his son while he was instructing him, "O my son, do not associate [anything] with Allah . Indeed, association [with him] is great injustice."

12-21.t: [And Luqman said], "O my son, indeed if wrong should be the weight of a mustard seed and should be within a rock or [anywhere] in the heavens or in the earth, Allah will bring it forth. Indeed, Allah is Subtle and Acquainted.

12-22.a: الَّذِينَ يُبَلِّغُونَ رِسَالَاتِ اللَّهِ وَيَخْشَوْنَهُ وَلَا يَخْشَوْنَ أَحَدًا إِلَّا اللَّهَ وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ حَسِيبًا
12-22.t: [ Allah praises] those who convey the messages of Allah and fear Him and do not fear anyone but Allah . And sufficient is Allah as Accountant.

12-23.t: O you who have believed, spend from the good things which you have earned and from that which We have produced for you from the earth. And do not aim toward the defective therefrom, spending [from that] while you would not take it [yourself] except with closed eyes. And know that Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy.

12-24.a: یَا أَیُّهَا الَّذِینَ آمَنُوا لِمَ تَقُولُونَ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ
12-24.t: O you who have believed, why do you say what you do not do?

12-24.a: كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ أَنْ تَقُولُوا مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ
12-24.t: Great is hatred in the sight of Allah that you say what you do not do.

12-25.a: أَتَأْمُرُونَ النَّاسَ بِالْبِرِّ وَتَنسَوْنَ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ تَتْلُونَ الْكِتَابَ أَفَلاَ تَعْقِلُونَ
12-25.t: Do you order righteousness of the people and forget yourselves while you recite the Scripture? Then will you not reason?

12-26.a: قُلْ یَا عِبَادِیَ الَّذِینَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ یَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِیعًا ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِیمُ
12-26.t: Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allah . Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."

12-27.a: وَإِنْ كَانَ ذُو عُسْرَةٍ فَنَظِرَةٌ إِلَىٰ مَیْسَرَةٍ ۚ وَأَنْ تَصَدَّقُوا خَیْرٌ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
12-27.t: And if someone is in hardship, then [let there be] postponement until [a time of] ease. But if you give [from your right as] charity, then it is better for you, if you only knew.

12-28.a: وَإِذَا مَسَّ الْإِنْسَانَ الضُّرُّ دَعَانَا لِجَنْبِهِ أَوْ قَاعِدًا أَوْ قَائِمًا فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُ ضُرَّهُ مَرَّ كَأَنْ لَمْ یَدْعُنَا إِلَىٰ ضُرٍّ مَسَّهُ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ زُیِّنَ لِلْمُسْرِفِینَ مَا كَانُوا یَعْمَلُونَ
12-28.t: And when affliction touches man, he calls upon Us, whether lying on his side or sitting or standing; but when We remove from him his affliction, he continues [in disobedience] as if he had never called upon Us to [remove] an affliction that touched him. Thus is made pleasing to the transgressors that which they have been doing

12-29.a: إِنْ یَنْصُرْكُمُ اللَّهُ فَلَا غَالِبَ لَكُمْ ۖ وَإِنْ یَخْذُلْكُمْ فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِی یَنْصُرُكُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ ۗ وَ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْیَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ
12-29.t: So by mercy from Allah , [O Muhammad], you were lenient with them. And if you had been rude [in speech] and harsh in heart, they would have disbanded from about you. So pardon them and ask forgiveness for them and consult them in the matter. And when you have decided, then rely upon Allah . Indeed, Allah loves those who rely [upon Him].

12-30.a: وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ادْعُونِی أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ الَّذِینَ یَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِی سَیَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِینَ
12-30.t: And your Lord says, "Call upon Me; I will respond to you." Indeed, those who disdain My worship will enter Hell [rendered] contemptible.

12-31.a: نَبِّئْ عِبَادِي أَنِّي أَنَا الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
12-31.t: Inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful.

about.a: قُلْ يا عِبادِيَ الَّذينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلى أَنْفُسِهِمْ لا تَقْنَطُوا مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَميعاً إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحيمُ
about.t: Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allah . Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."
